items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Wingy's a pretty shrewd boy when it comes to money. Yeah. He acts illiterate but he's pretty smart.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's probably the most copied and most famous trombone song.
You know, Wingy, you know that thing that the late Glenn Miller made, In a Mood? Yeah. That was Wingy's tune.
